title: Grass block crafting
description: With this datapack you can craft grass blocks!
body:
With this datapack you can craft grass blocks with dirt and grass or fern.

I don't have much to say...

![crafting grass](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a071eff4a8ba0828885ed491c067e7c6170d5a24.png)

![crafting fern](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/9d6ce327197aed7c28e89b82f218012d95a5ccb8.png)

Of course you can use it in your modpack, and credits will be appreciated!!
